name: HWiNFO Sensor Monitor
headline: Put Any HWiNFO Sensor on a Stream Deck Key or Dial
description:
HWiNFO Sensor Monitor turns a customer-installed HWiNFO sensor feed into a polished Stream Deck dashboard. Search hundreds of HWiNFO readings by hardware device, put any sensor on a key, graph rolling local history, combine several sensors into a compact dashboard, and add warning/critical threshold visualization.

Four focused actions: HWiNFO Sensor, HWiNFO Sensor Graph, HWiNFO Dashboard, and HWiNFO Sensor Alert. Stream Deck + dials rotate through selected sensors and the touch strip shows the current reading plus history. Ready-made dashboards are included for standard/MK.2, XL, Stream Deck +, and Neo.

Requires Windows, Stream Deck 7.3 or newer, and HWiNFO 7.0+ installed separately with Sensors and Shared Memory Support enabled. HWiNFO64 Free can disable Shared Memory after 12 hours of continuous runtime; when that happens this plugin shows the source as expired and asks you to re-enable it manually. It never restarts or re-enables HWiNFO to bypass that limit.

All readings and history stay local. No PackRat cloud, account, analytics, or telemetry. HWiNFO is not bundled or redistributed. Independent third-party integration; HWiNFO® is a trademark of REALiX, s.r.o. and is not affiliated with or endorsed by PackRat.
release_notes:
- Browse and display arbitrary HWiNFO Shared Memory sensors with stable duplicate-safe identities.
- Add rolling 30-second, 1-minute, and 5-minute graphs plus warning/critical threshold states.
- Build multi-sensor dashboards and rotate sensors from Stream Deck + dials with touch-strip history.
- Includes ready-made MK.2, XL, Stream Deck +, and Neo dashboards with clear HWiNFO setup and expiry states.
